stock.description: Xi'an Haitian Antenna Technologies Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated companies, is engaged in the entire lifecycle of mobile communication antennas and related solutions, from research and development to manufacturing, deployment, and distribution. Its market reach extends across the People's Republic of China and other nations within Asia. The company's diverse portfolio also includes specialized equipment for sub-aquatic and subterranean surveillance and imaging, mechanical apparatus, sophisticated alert and monitoring systems for challenging environments, and unmanned aerial vehicles specifically designed for agricultural and forestry sectors. Furthermore, it offers expert consultancy services and participates in the trade of building materials, as well as poultry and various farm produce. Established in 1999 and based in Xi'an, China, the entity operated under the name Xi'an Haitiantian Holdings Co., Ltd. until its corporate rebranding to Xi'an Haitian Antenna Technologies Co., Ltd. in August 2019.
